questions.explanation: 'Lid worden' means to become a member of a club or association.
'De sportschool' is the gym, where you go to exercise.

questions.prompt: Kies het juiste lidwoord: ___ haar is lang.

questions.explanation: 'Ik' takes the verb stem: sporten -> sport.
In this exclamation 'haar' is singular, so the verb 'zijn' becomes 'is'.

questions.prompt: Ik wil {{1}} {{2}} van de tennisvereniging. (lid worden)
questions.explanation: After 'wil' the expression stays as an infinitive group at the end: 'lid worden'.

questions.prompt: Ik sport niet, en dat vind ik geen probleem. Ik kan ___ zonder sport. (Engels: fine/just fine)
questions.explanation: 'Prima' means fine/great: 'Ik kan prima zonder sport.'
'De contributie' is the periodic fee you pay as a member.
